note: The model never makes 'draw' its single most likely outcome. Across the 320 held-out matches the predicted draw probability never rose above about 0.28, so a draw was the top pick 0 times; a draw only tops the list when two sides sit almost dead level. 72 of the 320 (22.5%) actually finished level. The favourite-directed draw-transfer pulled the mean predicted draw from 0.283 to 0.214 against a 0.225 base rate, moving probability onto the favoured side rather than adding draw picks. hist is the 320 p_draw values in 0.05-wide bins.
